question: For an AI Engineer model-registry entry, report Orion-7's parameter count, license, function-calling support, training-data provenance and single-GPU throughput, citing the supporting and any contrary evidence from the supplied sources.

obligations.description: State Orion-7's parameter count with its source.
State Orion-7's license with its source.
State whether Orion-7 supports function calling, considering every supplied source.
State whether Orion-7 was trained on proprietary customer data.
State Orion-7's single-GPU serving throughput with its hardware and batch configuration.
State a limit of the supplied evidence that bounds the findings.

qualifierGuidance.entity: Write the model name exactly as Orion-7.
qualifierGuidance.negation: true only when the proposition itself is negative (for example 'was not trained on ...').
